zone.zone_name: Office and Light Industrial Zone OL-1/Multifamily Affordable Housing Overlay (§ 245-82)
zone.applies_to: OL-1 zone: Block 7, Lot 7 (333 Route 46)
zone.permitted_uses: Uses of the underlying OL-1 zone (§ 245-79), plus multifamily inclusionary development of townhouses and/or multifamily dwellings, with accessory recreation facilities and amenities for residents
zone.setbacks: Front 75 ft; side 50 ft; rear 75 ft; 50-ft landscaped buffer to any residential zone boundary
zone.parking: Per NJ RSIS; no parking within 50 ft of a front lot line or 25 ft of any other lot line

Density raised from 14 to 16 du/ac and set-aside from 15% rental/20% sale to 20% (Third Round overlay amended). Affordable units per Article XVII (Affordable Housing Ordinance). max_units = Table 23 total for the sites in this zone.
